content.title: Doraemon
content.shortDescription: A robotic cat travels back from the 22nd century to help a boy named Nobita.
content.description: Doraemon is a robotic cat sent back in time from the 22nd century by Sewashi to help his accident-prone great-great-grandfather Nobita Nobi, using an array of futuristic gadgets pulled from his 4-dimensional pocket.
